dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular thin high-intensity perimeters (approx. 2-5 pixels wide) define several 'O' and 'C' shaped structures. There is a sharp luminance step-up from the dark exterior to the perimeter, followed by a rapid transition back to a darker interior, creating distinct closed-loop boundaries in the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Sparse spatial density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters is observed, primarily in the upper posterior region. These clusters lack internal luminance gradients and appear as irregular, non-geometric solid patches.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent macro-annuli in the central dorsal region form an obtuse triangle. A secondary linear chain of five smaller high-intensity blobs extends diagonally across the mid-lateral section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, vertical, high-intensity linear mark is visible on the posterior flank near the junction of the tail, appearing as a distinct temporal marking or healed scar.
other_distinctive_markers: A complex network of fine, high-intensity filamentous lines inter-connects the larger annuli, resulting in a contiguous 'web-like' topographical pattern across the lateral surface.
